grf.generated_hypothesis: The vulnerable-runtime WAL-to-DELETE migration boundary is conservatively fail-closed under concurrent foreign connections: if any other connection keeps the database open, SQLite refuses the journal-mode transition rather than silently switching beneath a live peer.
grf.causal_mechanism: Changing journal_mode from WAL to DELETE requires an exclusive-enough state transition. A second open connection prevents the transition and SQLite returns database-is-locked while preserving WAL mode.

grf.predicted_if_hypothesis_right: Single-connection baseline changes WAL to DELETE; idle/read/write second-connection cases fail with a lock error and journal_mode remains WAL.
